title: SieveScript/get args
description: Arguments for SieveScript/get (RFC 9661). Fetches SieveScript objects of an account.

accountId.description: The account to fetch scripts from.

ids.description: IDs of specific scripts to fetch. Null or omitted to fetch all scripts.

properties.description: SieveScript properties to include in the response. Null or omitted for all properties.
